info.title: cookwala-samples: runnable samples for the Cookwala Core 0.2 API.
info.description: The cookwala-samples command: the Cookwala samples demo, gates, planner and orchestrator on simulated devices or against a Cookwala hub, plus a small HTTP service. Samples, not certified software.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Plans, checks and cooks the bundled example recipes on four simulated devices, so every Cookwala role
(client, planner agent, orchestrator, safety gates, recovery, reporting) can be seen without hardware.
Nothing is really cooked, and everything runs offline unless you pass --hub.

commands.name: demo
commands.description: run the six-job demo and print its report

options.name: --format
options.description: report format: markdown (default), json, junit (for CI test reports) or csv

options.name: --out
options.description: write the report to FILE instead of standard output

options.name: --hub
options.description: run the fault-free jobs against a real Cookwala hub instead of the simulated kitchen

options.name: --token
options.description: bearer token for --hub (default: the COOKWALA_HUB_TOKEN environment variable)

commands.name: gates
commands.description: run the safety gates on one recipe and show which gate allows or refuses it

options.name: --device
options.description: also check this simulated device's capabilities (see `list`)

options.name: --human-present
options.description: a person is in the kitchen; recipes with steps that may not run unattended need this

options.name: --block
options.description: refuse if the recipe contains ALLERGEN; repeatable

commands.name: help
commands.description: show this help, or the help for one command

commands.name: list
commands.description: show the bundled recipes and simulated devices

commands.name: plan
commands.description: ask the planner agent to turn a dish into a checked cooking request

options.name: --servings
options.description: scale the recipe to N servings (default: as written in the recipe)

options.name: --block
options.description: refuse the plan if the recipe contains ALLERGEN; repeatable

options.name: --human-present
options.description: a person is in the kitchen, which changes which devices can take the job

arguments.name: DISH
arguments.description: a dish name, matched against the bundled recipes (see `list`)

commands.name: run
commands.description: cook one or more dishes on the simulated kitchen and report what happened

options.name: --human-present
options.description: a person is in the kitchen and can watch or confirm steps

options.name: --block
options.description: refuse any recipe containing ALLERGEN; repeat for more, e.g. --block eggs --block peanuts

options.name: --fault
options.description:
inject a fault at one step; KIND is sensor_fault, timeout or overheat; repeatable,
e.g. --fault 'example-koshari#n14=overheat'

options.name: --format
options.description: report format: markdown (default), json, junit or csv

options.name: --out
options.description: write the report to FILE instead of standard output

arguments.name: DISH
arguments.description: a dish name, matched against the bundled recipes (see `list`), e.g. lentil or koshari

commands.name: serve
commands.description: start the samples HTTP service (the same samples over HTTP)

options.name: --port
options.description: port to listen on (default: the PORT environment variable, else 8080)

options.name: --bind
options.description:
address to listen on (default: the BIND environment variable, else 127.0.0.1;
use 0.0.0.0 inside a container)

commands.name: version
commands.description: print the samples version and the Core version it speaks
